name: Arrows
overview: The Scripture presents arrows as instruments of God's judgment and destruction upon the wicked, as seen in Deuteronomy 32:23 where God declares He will 'spend mine arrows upon them' to bring mischief. This divine judgment is accompanied by severe afflictions like hunger and terror that destroy all ages (Deuteronomy 32:24-25). Yet, God restrains His wrath to prevent enemies from boasting that their power is their own, underscoring that all calamity ultimately comes from the LORD (Deuteronomy 32:27). The passage highlights the folly of those without counsel or understanding who face such judgment (Deuteronomy 32:28).
